description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate Willorawaththa, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520204 & three other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including detailed property descriptions (cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extent), claims processes for property ownership, and actions under the Registration of Title Act. It focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative procedures, fitting the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
